svg.title: From a question to a project
svg.desc: From a question to a project. Full text is available in PROFILE.md.

g.aria-label: From a question to a project

g.text: Start with the problem, the data, and the constraints before choosing a model or
Establish a baseline, compare results, and inspect errors as well as headline metrics.
Connect processing, inference or application logic, APIs, and an interface people can use.
Document assumptions and limitations, then use what the project reveals to guide the next
